lifecycle.sequence: ProductProvider -> ProductSession -> ProductSnapshot -> one typed product
lifecycle.time: requested time is retained in snapshot metadata; provider applicability controls domains
lifecycle.frames: named right-handed SI frames; quaternions are (x, y, z, w)
lifecycle.failures: unsupported capability, unsupported major, invalid request, and applicability are distinct typed failures

product_boundaries.visual: sectioned geometry and feature channels; no implied spectral or optical capability
product_boundaries.signature: unresolved source spectral radiant intensity; no atmosphere, optics, detector, or pixel claim
product_boundaries.ray_transfer: resolved source radiance and background transmittance with explicit hit/miss semantics
product_boundaries.engineering: conservative handoff quantities remain separate from rendering and radiometry

waived_providers.StaticPlumeProvider: legacy providers.lifecycle ABI; no canonical ProductSession adapter yet
waived_providers.ShockCellAnalyticalProvider: legacy spatial capability ABI; solver-private spatial products remain out of this freeze

evidence.wire_baseline: checked-in v1 schema and fixture digests match the 0.1.0a1 release-gate inventory

compatibility.legacy_prescribed_api: retained as a UUID/envelope compatibility shell backed by the canonical prescribed provider
compatibility.root_exports: retained and covered by import inventory tests
compatibility.removal_horizon: no earlier than 0.2.0 after a new major-version migration review
